name: workbuddy-token-usage
description: 只读查询 WorkBuddy 本地用量（上下文占比、credit、token 分项、近似速度、工具调用与预估费用），提供 token_usage MCP 工具与 /usage 命令。不改客户端文件、不注入 asar；牌价缓存按 12h 匿名同步（可关），无凭据上传。
description_en: Read-only local usage for WorkBuddy (context usage, credits, token breakdown, approx. speed, tool calls and estimated cost) via the token_usage MCP tool and the /usage command. No client modification, no asar injection; the price-table cache syncs anonymously every 12h (can be disabled).
